exposure: admission to neonatal intensive unit (NICU) after delivery
cohort: The study included 7336 women and their live, singleton, term newborns born in a private hospital in Athens, Greece, between January and December 2019.
finding: Several perinatal factors, including nulliparity, cesarean delivery, smoking during pregnancy, gestational age 37+0- 38+6 weeks, birthweight <2500g, and NICU admission, were associated with nonexclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with nonexclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge (OR 1.83; 95% CI 1.65, 2.03) compared to vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between January and December 2019, with outcomes observed at hospital discharge.
